summary: DESIGN-ONLY (no runs). Proposal at bench/frequency-methodology.md for user approval. Winnable = empirical ∧ external-gap ∧ load-bearing-retrievable-note (per note-mq7xtzmbsjm); true ground truth needs cold-vs-warm held-out A/B (expensive). 3 candidate methods: (a) live gate-logging — cheap, but measures 'gate would fire' + confounded by gate miscalibration (0.51 win was below 0.55 threshold); (b) sampled held-out A/B — real ground truth, expensive, blocked by per-task graders + cold-state replay, only viable on ~10 tasks; (c) retrospective graph analysis — cheap, classifies completed tasks for empirical-external-loadbearing note deps, no counterfactual. RECOMMENDED: phased — cheap proxy first (c+a) → small targeted A/B (b) to validate proxy. FIRST STEP: retrospective LLM-judge classification over the 62 completed tasks that already context-dep on a note → report winnable-rate + the external-gap BASE RATE (the ceiling indicator that bounds the whole payoff). Feasibility: workload is REAL (141 tasks/128 done, 145 notes, 346 ctx edges, 62 note-deps, transcripts+tokens present) so no need to synthesize one — but it's SELF-SIMILAR (orchestrator building itself, one operator), so any frequency is a point estimate for this distribution. Held-out rig exists (scripts/bench-heldout.js, 50d5cef).
